purpose: The declared sinks for DPK-SAST-258 and DPK-SAST-259 must both be reported from one fixture.

groundTruth.rationale: The fixture lines contain the exact constructs the rules declare: DPK-SAST-258 -> network.host: 0.0.0.0; DPK-SAST-259 -> xpack.security.enabled: false.

limitations: Fixture reuses each rule's declared positive example and executes it through the full evaluator; it proves wiring and non-regression, not independent semantic ground truth.
The final line is a safe counterpart: any detection on it is an unexpected line and fails the case.
